sn35.82:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā || la || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.82:2.2: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante loko ti vuccatīti || ||
sn35.82:2.3: Lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā loko ti vuccati || ||
sn35.82:2.6: Rūpā lujjanti || || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ lujjati || || Cakkhusamphasso lujjati || pe || ||
sn35.82:2.8: Yam pidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ vā || tam pi lujjati || || 10
sn35.82:2.9: Lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā lokoti vuccatīti || || 2
